THE IDEA BEHIND montset

Everyday objects.
Personal character.

A keyboard is part of the space you return to every day. This collection explores how a familiar object can carry a little more personality.

01 / THE PALETTE

Quiet, vivid, and everything between.

The collection brings together six keycap palettes and four case finishes, drawn from your supplied references. A soft ivory case changes the feel of graphite; deep blue gives honey a different kind of warmth.

02 / THE SIGNATURE

A line that ties it together.

Organic graphic accents appear across the reference keyboards, especially on the spacebar, Enter, and modifier keys. Our illustrated previews interpret that visual language.

03 / THE CURRENT CHAPTER

A collection to explore.

montset is a working brand concept. This site is a collection showcase and configuration tool. Product photography, final specifications, pricing, stock, and ordering details still need confirmation before sales launch.
